snippet.title: Muskurahat Bhi Neki Hai? | Sahih Muslim 2626 | Khaali Jeb, Phir Bhi Neki #shorts
snippet.description:
Kya muskurana bhi neki hai? Agar jeb khaali ho, tab bhi?

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Dharr Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ»
"Kisi bhi neki ko hargiz chhota na samjho, chahe yeh ho ke tum apne bhai se khile chehre ke saath milo."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 2626: https://sunnah.com/muslim:2626

Aaj ghar walon se, aur raaste ke anjaan se, muskura kar milein. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
